Hi Amy — great to see the spike (good signal that the integration is exercising realistic patterns). We can absolutely offer a bridge and a conversion incentive. High level options below — happy to hop on a short call to pick one and I can get the SOW updated.

Option A — Surge smoothing credit (fast, low legal overhead)
- We waive overage fees up to 25k tokens/day for the two-week bridge period.
- No change to overall price if you convert later; credit is a one-time concession.

Option B — Timebox extension + support boost
- Add a 14-day extension to your current evaluation at no charge.
- 8 support hours of dedicated onboarding help (priority queue + 2x shadow sessions).

Option C — Early-convert accelerator (best for rapid go-live)
- If you sign a 3-month committed package (min. $35k/mo list), we can provide 15% off per-token for first 90 days + waived integration ramp fee ($6k) + 4x onboarding hours.
- We also include a single technical health-check at month 2.

Operational notes:
- Any discount tied to a short committed term will require a simple addendum and finance sign-off.
- I attached a draft SOW with Option C sketched in so we can iterate.

If you want the smoothing credit only, we can approve that internally in 24–48 hours. If you want the accelerator, I need to route to Finance and Legal for a quick approval.

Which direction do you want to explore? I can set up a 30-min call tomorrow between 11a–1p PT.

Thanks —
Soojin

Soojin — fine to proceed with a constrained accelerator, with these guardrails:
- Approve the waived ramp fee ($6k) and the graduated discount (15% first 90d, 10% next 90d).
